Hi, I'm Monisha!

I'm a multidisciplinary Product Designer with a background in architecture and a master's in Human-Computer Interaction and Design from Indiana University Bloomington. My journey from designing physical spaces to digital experiences has shaped how I approach design—combining spatial thinking, user research, and a systems perspective to create intuitive, meaningful products.

Today, I work at the intersection of design, strategy, and technology, turning complex problems into simple, human-centered solutions. From interfaces to AI-powered tools, I love bringing ideas to life while balancing form, function, and impact.

Originally from Bangalore and now based in NYC, I enjoy collaborating across disciplines, exploring new ideas, and creating experiences that make a difference.

How I work

Make participation easier.

Accessibility and inclusion shape how I think about different abilities, contexts, and levels of digital confidence.

Let evidence change the direction.

I value adaptability: learning about the problem, questioning assumptions, and refining a design as needs evolve.

Give every interaction a purpose.

My architecture background informs my belief that visual decisions should help people understand and use an experience.

Connect disciplines.

I bring design into conversation with research, engineering, and business so the experience and the system behind it can work together.

What I bring to a team

A spatial perspective

Architecture taught me to consider how individual details shape a larger experience.

Interface and workflow thinking

My Rokt work spans UX/UI, research, automation, and CRM integration.

Outside work

I love traveling, discovering cultures, spending time at the piano, and heading to the beach.
